notes.note: Taranto top scored for the Tigers thanks mostly to his 7 tackles and 6 clearances. He hasn't been delivering big scores mostly because of the losses the Tigers have been suffering.
Taranto had a huge game in the win with his 32 touches 11 clearances and 9 tackles. He made the most of the win.
25 possessions for Taranto but just the 64% efficiency which did hurt his score.
Taranto had 27 disposals this week with the only reason he didn't get to 100+ was the 66% efficiency.
Taranto was good again with his 26 disposals but it was the 4 goals that really boosted his score. Not getting over 100 with the goals means he isn't one to upgrade to.
Taranto ended as the leader in Contested possessions and clearances with 15 and 7.
Taranto was the highlight for the Tigers with 2 goals and 29 disposals. His second best this year.
Taranto will miss this week with concussion after he had just 10 disposals and 45% time on ground this week.
Taranto isn't back to the form of his first season at Richmond but he has posted 4 over 100 in a row now as he is taking control of the Tigers midfield.
Taranto was the best for the Tigers and it marks three over 100 in a row for him with his biggest score this season with 10 tackles and 2 goals a part of his game.

As we have seen in the past Taranto got plenty of the footy but he just isn't one that we need to have in our sides. He scored well but the Tigers will struggle during the year which will limit his scoring.
